about.intro: I am a passionate designer and developer from Lviv, Ukraine, who combines design and technology. My work is based on a belief in pure aesthetics and functionality.

text: Designed a comprehensive landing page and interface for an artificial intelligence platform. Developed visual identity, responsive layouts, and interactive animations to enhance user engagement.

Worked on personal app and website projects using Figma. Motivated by solving real user problems through design and constantly improving my skills. Proficient in Figma, design systems, prototyping, and visual storytelling.
Studying at the Faculty of Information Technology and Telecommunication Networks with a focus on computer networks, data transmission systems, and modern IT solutions.
Coursework includes network architecture, cybersecurity, programming, and the basics of UI/UX design.
